zh-HK: NB 分析新增每月獨立 Sales／Margin Target、季度及年度 KPI，並按已設定月份加權計算目標與追數進度
季度／年度 NB 新增過去紀錄、Segmentation、Last Order 及雙工作表 Excel 匯出，並修正取消單 cohort 與 adjustment 雜訊
MTD Margin Calculator 可由合併 Sales History 搜尋帳戶及選取 Order，自動帶入 Sales Amount 與加權 Margin
客戶銷售指標標題改為去年同月 Sales 及 MTD YoY，與實際數據口徑一致
平台預設 Stock-only Item 現會以無價格虛擬產品加入 Item Code／Description 搜尋，補齊 9,226 個只存在於 stock.default.js 的項目
en: NB analytics now supports monthly Sales and Margin targets plus quarterly and annual KPIs, with weighted targets and pacing based on configured months
Quarterly and annual NB history now includes segmentation, last order, and two-sheet Excel export, with fixes for cancelled-order cohorts and adjustment noise
The MTD Margin Calculator can search merged Sales History by account and select orders to populate Sales Amount and weighted Margin
Customer sales indicator labels now correctly describe prior-year same-month Sales and MTD YoY
Platform default product and stock data has been refreshed: Products 2026-08-28-001 (5,269 records) and Stock 2026-08-25-001 (14,280 records)
Platform Stock-only items are now added to Item Code and Description search as unpriced virtual products, covering 9,226 items found only in stock.default.js
